summary: Build the plugin installer and manager acquisition tools with Go 1.26.11.
userImpact: Plugin acquisition and signature verification retain their existing interfaces.

instructions: Adopt the qualified installer and manager images when they are published.

security: Go 1.26.11 fixes CVE-2026-97054 in the standard library linked into ORAS and Cosign.

customerDocumentation.reason: The rebuilt images use the existing installation and upgrade procedures.

rollback: Prefer the next qualified forward build because older image digests carry the affected Go version.
validation: Both image definitions verify Go 1.26.11 in the emitted ORAS and Cosign binaries before packaging them.
